connect.snippet.generic.note: From a container or devcontainer use host.docker.internal instead of 127.0.0.1 and add it under Extra allowed hosts ({path}).

connect.snippet.cursor.warning: Cursor sends model requests from its own servers, so 127.0.0.1 and local-network addresses do not work. Cursor needs a public HTTPS address, which PingDeck does not provide. A tunnel plus an allowed host ({path}) can reach the gateway: a token is still required, the gateway is then exposed to the internet, and tunnels are outside PingDeck's support.
connect.rotate.warn: Any other tool where you pasted the old token stops working. PingDeck only knows the files it wrote.

cfg.opt.flag.tools_via_responses.d: Auto sends them over Responses for OpenAI reasoning models.
cfg.opt.flag.stream_usage.d: Asks streamed answers to end with token usage. Default On.
cfg.opt.header.auth: Set by PingDeck from the auth style
cfg.opt.header.duplicate: That header is already in the list
cfg.opt.header.full: A provider holds at most 32 headers
cfg.opt.header.long: A value holds at most 4,096 bytes
cfg.opt.header.name: A header name has letters, digits and dashes only
cfg.opt.url.host: Enter an address with a host
cfg.opt.url.scheme: Use an http or https address
cfg.sec.compat.d: Auto follows the preset. Tests suggest, and nothing changes until you apply.
cfg.sec.endpoints.d: One base URL; each protocol adds its own path prefix and PingDeck adds the request path.
cfg.sec.headers.d: Sent with every request to this provider. Credential values are stored write-only.
cfg.sec.models.d: For models the provider does not list. Listed models are in the Models tab.
cfg.secret.down: Secret storage is unavailable: {reason}. Keys cannot be read or saved.
cfg.host.title: Send this provider's requests to another host?
cfg.host.body: Requests go to {to} instead of {from}. Enabled keys switched off (values kept): {keys}. Switch a key back on once you trust the new host. The scan and the balance readings of the old host are cleared.
cfg.host.kept: Not saved: the provider still sends to {from}.
cfg.host.enableBody: The provider moved to {host} and its keys were switched off. Switch this key on only if you trust {host}.
cfg.stale.provider: This provider was just changed elsewhere. The latest copy is loaded; save again to apply your change.
cfg.stale.key: This key was just changed elsewhere. The latest copy is loaded; save again to apply your change.
cfg.declared.title: Declared values of {model}
cfg.declared.tokensWhole: Enter a whole number of tokens
prov.recent.title: Recent calls
gwa.f.ai.gateway.capture_mode.d: Which gateway exchanges keep their request and response bodies for debugging.
gwa.f.ai.gateway.enabled_on_start.d: Start the gateway when PingDeck opens, so clients work without visiting Providers first.
gwa.f.ai.gateway.extra_allowed_hosts.d: For Docker and tunnels, such as host.docker.internal or a tunnel's host name. Works with Serve on local network off.
gwa.f.ai.gateway.port.d: Changing it restarts the gateway. Clients already configured keep the old port until you rewrite their config below.
gwa.f.ai.gateway.require_token.d: Every call needs a client token. Off: a call with no token is allowed and logged as Anonymous. A token that matches no active client (revoked, rotated or unknown) always gets 401, whatever this setting says.
gwa.f.ai.gateway.serve_lan.d: Off: only apps on this computer can connect. On: any device on your Wi-Fi or LAN that has a token can.
gwa.gateway.capture.all: Prompts and replies are stored on this computer for {days} days, without encryption. Secrets that match known patterns are removed; other private text is not.
gwa.gateway.capture.clear: Space used and clean-up are in Data and sync › Storage.
gwa.gateway.capture.errors_only: Failed requests keep their prompts and replies on this computer for {days} days, without encryption. Secrets that match known patterns are removed; other private text is not.
gwa.gateway.capture.growth: The log grows quickly with every body kept.
gwa.gateway.capture.limits: Kept: the last {rows} requests or {days} days. Captured bodies: {bodyDays} days or {mb} MB; the oldest go first. Keys and tokens are removed before a body is written.
gwa.gateway.capture.off: Request bodies are not stored. Exchanges you keep from Requests are the exception.
gwa.gateway.client.migrated: Migrated from the old shared token. Rotate it when your tools use their own tokens.
gwa.gateway.client.revoked.note: Revoked {ago}. Its token now gets 401, with Require tokens on or off.
gwa.gateway.clients.empty.d: Create a client so an app can use the gateway, or connect one of the apps below.
gwa.gateway.create.d: One client per app. Its token is shown once after you create it.
gwa.gateway.create.name: Name
gwa.gateway.create.title: Create a client
gwa.gateway.failover.pre: Waits and retries after a failure follow
gwa.gateway.hosts.inactive: Not active: Serve on local network is off
gwa.gateway.lan.dlg.body: Any device on your Wi-Fi or LAN that has a client token can then call the gateway on port {port}. Tokens stay required while this is on.
gwa.gateway.lan.dlg.none: This Mac's addresses are listed here once the gateway serves the network.
gwa.gateway.lan.dlg.title: Serve on the local network?
gwa.gateway.legacy.confirm: Stop accepting the old alias names?
gwa.gateway.legacy.confirm.d: A tool whose config still sends one of them gets a not-found error. Write its config again first if you are not sure.
gwa.gateway.line.off: Runs inside PingDeck and is not listening now. It uses port {port} when it starts.
gwa.gateway.line.pre: Runs inside PingDeck and listens on
gwa.gateway.models.title: Models for {name}
gwa.gateway.limits.title: Limits for {name}. Empty fields mean no limit.
gwa.gateway.limits.mapUnknown: Send unknown model names to the default model
gwa.gateway.limits.mapUnknown.d: A bare model name the gateway does not know is served by the model this client was last connected with. The call log shows the name the tool sent next to the model that answered.
gwa.gateway.name.taken: A client with this name already exists
gwa.gateway.once.copyFailed: Could not copy the token. Select it and copy it by hand: it is not shown again.
gwa.gateway.once.note: Copy it now. Afterwards only the last four characters are visible: {hint}.
gwa.gateway.once.title: Token for {name}
gwa.gateway.picker.allNote: This client can call every model, including ones you add later.
gwa.gateway.picker.pick: Pick at least one model or choose All models
gwa.gateway.port.body: Open connections are dropped. Clients already configured keep the old port until you rewrite their config below.
gwa.gateway.port.title: Restart the gateway on :{port}?
gwa.gateway.remove.body: The revoked client leaves this list. Its past requests keep the name in the log.
gwa.gateway.remove.title: Remove {name}?
gwa.gateway.revoke.body: Its token gets 401 from the next request. The row stays as Revoked and its log rows keep the client name.
gwa.gateway.revoke.title: Revoke {name}?
gwa.gateway.rotate.d: The current token ({hint}) stops working at once.
gwa.gateway.rotate.how: How to deliver the new token
gwa.gateway.rotate.reveal.d: Shows the new token once. Programs using the old token stop working at once.
gwa.gateway.rotate.title: Rotate the token of {name}
gwa.gateway.rotate.update.d: The new token goes straight into the files PingDeck wrote for this client. It never reaches this window.
gwa.gateway.rotate.update.none: PingDeck wrote no config file for this client.
gwa.gateway.tokens.forced: Needed while serving on the network
gwa.gateway.tokens.forcedHosts: Needed while extra allowed hosts are set
gwa.gateway.tokens.off.body: Any program on this computer can use your keys. Calls without a token run as Anonymous. A call that sends a token PingDeck does not recognise (revoked, rotated or unknown) is still refused with 401.
gwa.gateway.tokens.off.title: Turn off Require tokens?
gwa.gateway.writer.updateAddress.for: Write the gateway's current address into {name} without changing its token
gwa.gateway.writer.addressUpdated: {name} now points at the gateway's current address
gwa.routing.rule.d: The gateway tries these models in order, at most {max}. Their own rules are not followed.
gwa.routing.rule.reason.embedding_model: Only the same embedding model on another provider
gwa.routing.rule.title: When {model} fails
gwa.routing.rule.warnTitle: Saved. Requests that need what these models lack will skip them:
gwa.routing.rules.d: When a client (Claude Code, Codex…) asks the gateway for the model on the left and it fails, the gateway tries the models on the right, in order. The agent's own fallbacks are set in {agent} and {subagents}.
gwa.routing.rules.empty: No rules: a failed request is returned to the client as it is.
gwa.rules.st.disabled: Primary model disabled; rule still applies
gwa.preview.title: Route preview
gwa.preview.limit: At most {n} attempts. 401, 402, 403 and 429 switch keys; 5xx, timeouts and unknown models move to the next target; other 4xx return at once.
gwa.sec.clients.d: One token per app, limited to the models you pick. Revoking takes effect on the next request.
gwa.sec.hosts.d: A request's Host must be one of these, or it gets 403. Browser requests (with an Origin header) are always refused.
gwa.sec.server.d: Where the gateway listens and who may call it.
gw.view.access.kw: Gateway access 网关访问 port 端口 LAN 局域网 token 令牌 hosts 主机
gw.view.clients.kw: Gateway clients 网关客户端 token 令牌
gw.view.rules.kw: Gateway fallback rules 网关备用规则 routing 路由
gw.notice.lan_off: Local network access is off: no active client is left.
gw.notice.lan_address_changed: This Mac's local network address changed: {detail}
gw.notice.tokens_forced: Tokens are required: extra allowed hosts are set, so a call without a client token gets 401.
gw.notice.fallbacks_narrowed: Some clients skip fallback targets outside their allowed models: {detail}
gwa.gateway.client.restoreOriginal.title: Restore the original config of {name}?
gwa.gateway.revoke.files: These files still hold its token; the tools stop working until you connect them again or restore their original config under Files PingDeck changed.
gwa.gateway.rotate.skipped: Skipped, no longer held the old token: {files}
gwa.gateway.restore.body.original: Every file goes back to what it was before PingDeck took the tool over. Review the changes; the current content is backed up first.
gwa.gateway.restore.body.previous: A file changed after PingDeck wrote it, so nothing was restored yet. Review the changes; all files of the tool are restored together and the current content is backed up first.
gwa.gateway.restore.nothing: Nothing to restore: the files already hold that content.
gwa.gateway.managed.title: Files PingDeck changed
gwa.gateway.managed.purge.title: Delete the copies PingDeck keeps of {name}?
gwa.gateway.managed.purge.body: The original, the safety backups and the older backups are deleted, and Restore original config is no longer possible. The backups of the latest write stay so it can still be undone.
gwa.gateway.managed.note: Backups and originals are kept in PingDeck's data folder, owner-only. They hold your own config, API keys included, in plain text; backups go after 30 days.
connect.file.realPath: Through a symbolic link, the write lands in {path}
connect.file.git: This file is inside the Git work tree {path}. Do not commit the gateway token.
connect.verify.rejected: Received a request from {name} but it was rejected ({status})
connect.allow.label: Allowed models
connect.allow.add: Also add {model} to the allowed models
connect.allow.declined: Unchecked: the token still only allows {models}, and {name} will be refused.
connect.name.replacesRevoked: A revoked record named “{name}” will be replaced.
models.note.auth: Key rejected. Check whether it expired or was deleted.
models.note.quota: Out of credit or in arrears.
models.note.modelDenied: This key can't use this model.
models.note.modelDeniedRelay: This key can't use this model. Enable it for this group in the relay's console.
models.note.modelMissing: The provider has no such model, or the model name is wrong.
models.note.badRequest: The provider didn't accept this request's parameters (most likely a compatibility issue).
models.note.contextLimit: The request exceeds this model's context or output limit.
models.note.otherNoCode: The provider returned no usable answer.
models.row.old.tip: A result from more than 7 days ago; it may no longer hold.
prov.key.st.listFailed: Couldn't read the models it can use · {scope}
prov.key.st.listFailedCode: Couldn't read the models it can use ({code}) · {scope}
prov.key.st.listKept: it keeps the models it was last read with
prov.key.st.listNone: it only gets models no other key lists
prov.key.st.modelRejected: A model refused it ({status}); other models work
